claims.summary: Missing, unreadable, malformed, stale, and observed peer evidence must remain distinguishable.
claims.disposition: Verify source status plus age and freshness fields.

claims.summary: Last-known peer scalars must not be retained as current presence after a failed read.
claims.disposition: Preserve the no-stale-value invariant and explicit unknown relation.

claims.summary: Pressure-driven refresh or a ghosting buffer used by runtime behavior would change peer or sensory semantics.
claims.disposition: Preserve an exact Mike/operator approval wait before adaptive refresh, stale retention, or peer coupling.
